event_name: FIA Formula One World Championship Brazilian Grand Prix Thursday Press Conference Transcript
from: my side that weekend went really well from the start. Qualifying wasn't maybe the best for us but we were a little bit closer to the group in front, which usually means on race day we are a little bit better than them. It turned out to be that way. I think the tyre degradation helped us quite a lot there to be a bit more competitive and to make a bit of a difference. It was nice to finish eighth and get some points on the board and also quite important for us for the Constructors' Championship.
